name: External API
description: Reusable external API integration guidance for authentication, timeouts, retries, idempotency, rate limits, partial failure, reconciliation, and versioning.
activation_conditions: Requirement sends data to or receives data from an external service.
known_limitations: Does not replace provider-specific API documentation.
conflict_policy: Surface DOMAIN_PROJECT_CONFLICT or DOMAIN_DOMAIN_CONFLICT; provider documentation may override generic guidance.
